verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a native iOS/iPadOS Git client that installs and runs on the user's own device, so there is no hosted service to self-host and the axis is a category error for this kind of product. Its support for self-hosted Git servers (GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Gitea, Linux/NAS over SSH) is about connecting to the user's own infrastructure. That is not self-hosting Working Copy itself, so it does not make the axis applicable.
